criteria.description: Double-entry bookkeeping, journal entries and general ledger maintenance
criteria.supported: Describes journal entries/double-entry work and maintaining the general ledger
criteria.partial: Demonstrates only one area or lists the bookkeeping skills without tasks
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.supported: Describes reconciling bank accounts and investigating discrepancies
criteria.partial: Lists reconciliations or describes them without discrepancy investigation
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.description: Accounts payable and accounts receivable records
criteria.supported: Describes maintaining both AP and AR records
criteria.partial: Describes one of AP/AR or lists both without tasks
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.supported: Describes using both Excel formulas and pivot tables for accounting work
criteria.partial: Demonstrates one of formulas/pivots or lists both without an example
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.description: Accounting software or an ERP system
criteria.supported: Names and describes using an accounting/ERP system for accounting tasks
criteria.partial: Names a relevant system without usage evidence
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.description: At least two years of professional accounting experience
criteria.supported: States at least two years or gives non-overlapping dated accounting roles totaling at least 24 months
criteria.partial: Establishes professional accounting work but duration is short or unclear
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.description: Month-end closing and support for year-end closing
criteria.supported: Describes month-end closing tasks and year-end closing support
criteria.partial: Establishes month-end closing only or lists closing without specific tasks
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.description: Financial reports or supporting financial schedules
criteria.supported: Describes preparing financial reports or supporting schedules
criteria.partial: Lists reporting without an identifiable deliverable
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.supported: Describes maintaining accounting documentation and responding to audit requests
criteria.partial: Establishes one of documentation or audit-request support
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.

criteria.description: Optional budgeting/variance analysis, payroll, inventory accounting or IFRS
criteria.supported: Describes practical use of two or more preferred accounting areas
criteria.partial: Describes practical use of one preferred area or only lists several
criteria.not_demonstrated: The CV does not establish this requirement; do not infer that the applicant lacks it.
